# Traction Outsourcing Limited
> HR outsourcing, corporate restructuring, and business advisory firm based in Abuja, Nigeria, serving businesses across Nigeria and Africa.

## About
Traction Outsourcing Limited helps Nigerian businesses fix structure, leadership, and staffing problems through HR outsourcing, corporate restructuring, staff recruitment, and executive advisory work. Founded by Prince Elijah Abumoye.

## Books & Resources
- [Nigerian Bosses Are Bad](https://tolnigeria.com/books/): E-book by Prince Elijah Abumoye on why Nigerian workplaces are led by bosses employees call unfair or difficult, and what pressure and poor structure have to do with it. Available exclusively as an e-book, purchased via WhatsApp on this page. Also on this page: a free Nigerian Payroll Excel Template (updated for 2026 tax laws).

## Services
- [Staff Outsourcing](https://tolnigeria.com/services/staff-outsourcing/): Recruitment and management of outsourced staff for Nigerian businesses.
- [Corporate Restructuring](https://tolnigeria.com/services/corporate-restructuring/): Restructuring services for businesses undergoing organizational change.
- [Business Advisory](https://tolnigeria.com/services/business-advisory/): Strategic and operational advisory for business owners and executives.
- [Startup Structuring](https://tolnigeria.com/services/startup-structuring/): Helping early-stage companies set up sound business and HR structure.
- [Employee Training](https://tolnigeria.com/services/employee-training/): Corporate training programs for teams and leadership.
- [Corporate Retreats](https://tolnigeria.com/services/events/): Planning and execution of corporate retreats.
- [Bank Outsourcing](https://tolnigeria.com/services/bank-outsourcing/): Outsourced staffing solutions for banks and financial institutions.
